editorial.blurb: Truth Chicago serves thoughtfully prepared American comfort food with exceptional service in a welcoming, art-filled space that celebrates Black culture and community.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit during their happy hour (ask the restaurant for current times, as hours were recently extended under new ownership as of August 2025) or come for breakfast to try their standout salmon croquettes.
signatureDishes: Chicken and Rib Eye Sliced Steak

topDishes.note: Incredible array of fruity flavors with real fruit, beautifully executed
Very flavorful, worth ordering in a restaurant rather than cooking at home
Delicious and satisfying, part of their special menus
